items.title: Review: After the Budget, Before the Bell With The Opening Trade
items.summary: With Britain at a fiscal crossroads, Chancellor John Healey delivered the nation's annual budget in Parliament on Wednesday. As the UK's borrowing costs, its ties to Europe and growth outlook hang in the balance, "The Opening Trade" took Bloomberg.com subscribers behind the scenes for an exclusive broadcast in front of a live audience as UK gilt, equity and currency markets opened. (Source: Bloomberg)
